tests.comment: https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-patterns a Quantifier follows something (Term :: Atom Quantifier), so a pattern cannot begin with one

tests.comment: https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-patterns-static-semantics-early-errors it is a Syntax Error if the first ClassAtom of a range has a greater CharacterValue than the second

an unterminated character class is invalid
